description: List orders with filters by status, customer name, number, and created-date range. Returns (summary): pagination + array of {id, number, status, total, customer, phone, itemCount, createdAt}. Use detail:'full' for line items/delivery/payments, raw:true for the untouched payload.

detail.description: Output verbosity: 'summary' (compact, default — saves tokens) or 'full' (all shaped fields incl. line items, delivery, payments).

filter_date_from.description: Filter orders created on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

filter_date_to.description: Filter orders created on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

filter_status.description: Filter by order status code (e.g. 'new', 'complete'). Call list_statuses for valid codes.

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

name: list_orders
